Here is the prompt to paste into a Claude Code session on your Mac, started in your degen checkout (add ios-adblock if you want it covered too). It reads only and changes nothing:

In this checkout, read only, change and post nothing. 1) Find which lock a Mac session uses when it merges: search the merge tool and hooks for GitLock and GhLock and say which one runs on a Mac outside the cloud. 2) Find the simulator drive path (skills/ios-apps and the simulator tool) and say whether a drive that reuses an already booted simulator takes a lease. For each of the two, quote file and line, and say whether it matches (a) main's rule (GitLock only in the cloud, else GhLock; a reuse takes no lease) or (b) the owner's Nov 12 words (a Mac uses GitLock; every drive takes a lease). If both versions would give the same result on this Mac, say so. Report in 10 lines.

Paste its report into this item's note and I rule from facts. Until then main's rules stand and nothing waits on this.
